cached = cachetools.func.fifo_cache(lambda n: n)

class RecursiveEquals:
    def __init__(self, use_cache):
        self._use_cache = use_cache

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash(self._use_cache)

    def __eq__(self, other):
        print(f"__eq__ called: {self._use_cache} == {other._use_cache}")
        if self._use_cache:
            print("  calling cached(self)...")
            result = cached(self)
            print(f"  cached returned: {result}")
        return self._use_cache == other._use_cache

# Prime the cache.
print("Priming cache...")
cached(RecursiveEquals(False))
cached(RecursiveEquals(True))
print("Done priming.")

# Then do a call which will cause a deadlock with a non-reentrant lock.
print("Calling cached(RecursiveEquals(True))...")
result = cached(RecursiveEquals(True))
print(f"Result: {result}")
